phoneNumber.enableCountryCodeHelper: When enabled, phone number fields will show a country code selector with automatic country detection.

phoneNumber.minLengthHelper: Minimum number of characters required for a phone number.
phoneNumber.maxLengthHelper: Maximum number of characters allowed for a phone number.
phoneNumber.noteContent:
For local format (no country code): Set min/max based on your country's phone number length (e.g. 8-15 for most countries).
For international format (with country code enabled): Recommended min: 7, max: 20. This includes country code (1-4 digits) + phone number (usually 6~15 digits).
